home.steps.title: Send your first request in minutes

home.steps.signUp.description: Register with a username or email, then sign in. The available sign-in methods are set by this site's administrator.

home.steps.call.description: Set your client or SDK base URL to `{{baseUrl}}` and use a model id returned by `GET /v1/models`.

home.clients.other.title: Other OpenAI-compatible apps
home.clients.other.description: Choose OpenAI-compatible or custom API in the app, set the base URL to `{{baseUrl}}` and paste your key. If it asks for a full endpoint, use `{{endpoint}}`.
home.faq.title: Questions people ask before connecting
home.faq.description: The docs have step-by-step troubleshooting for more cases.
home.faq.models.question: Which models can I call?
home.faq.models.answer: It depends on what the administrator has configured and on your key settings (group, model limits). Call `GET /v1/models` with your key; each `data[].id` in the response is a model name you can use.
home.faq.address.question: Should the base URL include /v1?
home.faq.address.answer: OpenAI-compatible clients and SDKs use `{{v1}}`. Claude native clients such as Claude Code, and Gemini native clients, use the site root `{{root}}`. If an app asks for a full endpoint, use `{{endpoint}}`.
home.faq.quota.question: How is account balance different from key quota?
home.faq.quota.answer: They are two independent limits: every call is charged to your account balance, while key quota caps how much a single key may spend. If either runs out, requests fail.
home.faq.topUp.question: How do I add balance?
home.faq.topUp.answer: After signing in, top up online or redeem a code on the Wallet page. Only the methods this site enables are shown; if none are available, contact the administrator.
home.faq.errors.question: A request failed. Where do I start?
home.faq.errors.answer: Read the reason in `error.message` of the response JSON first, then find the request in Usage logs in the console. The docs walk through the common key, quota, model and rate-limit problems step by step.
home.faq.keyLeak.question: What if my key leaks?
home.faq.keyLeak.answer: Delete it on the API keys page right away and create a new one; a deleted key stops working immediately. For keys used in shared environments, set a quota cap, an expiry and model limits.
home.footer.tagline: AI model API gateway: one key for OpenAI, Claude and Gemini formats.
